question: Does the official DENR-NCR 2025 Annual Report add usable species-by-waterbody data for the 2024 Pasig River system biodiversity assessment?

source.publisher: Department of Environment and Natural Resources - National Capital Region
source.title: DENR-NCR Annual Report 2025
source.reportSection: 3.2.8 Biodiversity Assessment Study of the Pasig River
source.accessFinding: The official search index returned the report section text; a direct PDF fetch from the official PDF URL returned HTTP 403 in this check. No access control was bypassed and no local PDF copy was saved.
source.licenseFinding: No item-specific open-data license or republication permission was identified in the reviewed report text.

scopeFindings.interpretation: The report describes a 2024 assessment of the Pasig River system, names five main-river sampling points, three major tributaries, and minor Manila esteros. The listed rivers/esteros are the reported survey scope, not a complete NCR waterbody inventory or a species-by-site crosswalk.

reportNarrativeNames.reportContext: Named in the high-level native-fish narrative; the reviewed section provides no species-by-station count, capture date, specimen identifier, or separate method crosswalk.

reportNarrativeNames.currentTaxonomyNote: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes recognizes Moolgarda seheli as the valid name; retain the report's original spelling in source notes and do not infer a particular collection record from this name change.
reportNarrativeNames.reportContext: Named in the high-level native-fish narrative; the reviewed section provides no species-by-station count, capture date, specimen identifier, or separate method crosswalk.

reportNarrativeNames.interpretation: Common-name-only text; not taxonomically resolved to one or more species.

fishFindings.tableAvailability: The reviewed section provides a narrative but no fish table that maps these names to a station, tributary, date, count, specimen, or voucher.

scopeAndReuseDecision.decision: Official assessment-scope and high-level narrative lead only; no site-level fish assertions or app projection.
scopeAndReuseDecision.reason: The report does not give the required site-by-species mapping, the source PDF was not directly retrievable in this check, and item-specific redistribution terms were not verified. A high-level regional narrative cannot be assigned to individual rivers or esteros.

nonClaims: The report's named tributaries and esteros do not establish that every listed fish was collected at each waterbody.
A source-reported native-fish narrative is not an independently verified native-status assessment or species-by-site occurrence record.
The report's water-quality or contaminant discussion is not a food-safety advisory or personal consumption recommendation.
The listed rivers, points, and esteros do not settle NCR's complete waterbody denominator or establish fishing access, legal rules, or a complete fish checklist.
nextActions: Use the report to guide future searches for the underlying 2024 fish assessment tables, stations, methods, and specimen records through lawfully accessible sources.
Keep the source names and native-status wording explicitly attributed to DENR-NCR until a taxon-by-site dataset and its reuse terms are independently reviewed.
Continue NCR and the remaining Luzon region baselines; this report refresh does not mark any region complete.
